name: Mochlodon
sum: A rhabdodontid from the Late Cretaceous of Austria and Hungary, named for the bar-like ridge on its teeth.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: PIUW 2349, from the Grünbach Formation of the Gosau Group, Austria (Early Campanian, about 80 Ma).
material: The type remains only in the sources consulted.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Seeley 1881
